mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties that are additive, and amantadine may inhibit metabolism of oxybutynin, increasing its systemic exposure and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor closely for anticholinergic toxicity (urinary retention, constipation, confusion, tachycardia, hyperthermia); consider dose reduction of oxybutynin or alternative agents; assess renal function as both drugs are renally cleared.
